description: background-image with a JPEG, a WebP and a GIF in a data URL, each at its own size, and the JPEG drawn at half its size.

florui.css: .wrap { position: relative; width: 220px; height: 150px; background-color: #ffffff; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-content: flex-start; } .wrap > div { width: 96px; height: 64px; margin: 6px 6px 0 6px; background-repeat: no-repeat; } .j { background-image: url('data:image/jpeg;base64,'); } .w { background-image: url('data:image/webp;base64,'); } .g { background-image: url('data:image/gif;base64,'); } .s { background-image: url('data:image/jpeg;base64,'); background-size: 48px 32px; }

classification.reason: Measured against Chromium 155 on Windows: the JPEG, the WebP and the GIF decode to the same pixels within 5 per channel, drawn at their own size and at half of it; 0.0% of the pixels differ beyond the tolerance. Without the decoders the same fixture measures 60.5%, so it fails.
